sources.title: Mauricio Pochettino interview: 'We need to breathe, we need to feel the love, we need emotion'
sources.quote_checked: The worst thing as a human being is to underestimate the people in front of you. | At the end, the human skills are going to be the most important. | We need to breathe, we need to feel the love, we need emotion. Football is a contest of emotion.

sources.title: Mauricio Pochettino exclusive: Spurs manager's fascinating man-management blueprint
sources.quote_checked: Because players are people. They are not furniture. | I need to be aware of 25 players and what we've talked about, remember every single situation.

sources.title: 13 quotes to explain Pochettino's philosophy: 'He controlled everything'
sources.quote_checked: I never promised my players that they will play. | you don't sign to play, you sign to train. | the most important thing is to be consistent in what you do.

sources.title: Sharing your vision with your players
sources.quote_checked: we should always see an individual as a person before we see them in their professional capacity.

sources.title: The inside story of Manchester United's move for Mauricio Pochettino
sources.quote_checked: We recovered our capacity to dream big, the capacity to train players that really want to improve.
